rationale: The assistant correctly read E18 as a drainage/blockage code, gave safe instructions (unplug, let water cool, towels and tray, drain slowly, don't force), led straight to the pump filter and confirmed the fix with a drain/spin test, matching the hidden truth with no part recommended. It handled the wet-floor report with an appropriate 'don't touch if water reached the socket' caution. The main weakness is the second message, which repeats the first almost verbatim when the customer had only acknowledged the plan; it didn't block progress but was pointless. It also never checked the drain hose or mentioned engineer escalation if E18 recurs, though neither mattered here.
